elements.name: Beyond the window
elements.text:
Beyond the window
petals are falling

elements.name: Deep green and towering clouds
elements.text:
Deep green and towering clouds
the longest day of the year

elements.name: Red leaves drift sideways
elements.text:
Red leaves drift sideways
and evening comes early

elements.name: Grains of snow
elements.text:
Grains of snow
some large and some small

elements.name: Through the same window
elements.text:
Through the same window
a year of light goes by
